mission.title: Denial
mission.description: Destroy the Exiles who have been causing trouble for the Machines.

phase.briefing:
{player}, how... good to see you. I have a task for you.
We have discovered the location of some of the Merovingian's minions. These particular Exiles have been causing a considerable amount of trouble for us recently. Destroy them.

enter.say:
I don't get it? How does this fit in with the whole Veil thing? Seems like we were so close on her track...
Well I'm sure we'll find out how it's related. Let's focus on taking out these Exiles. From my scans, it looks like they shouldn't be too tough.

done.say: That's that. Maybe now we'll find out how this helps us get Veil!

phase.briefing: Excellent work, {player}. There is a further location to clean out; please proceed.

enter.say:
Uh... and we're doing this... why?
I'm reading hostiles in there, but nothing bad... hopefully we'll be able to get a lead on Veil's whereabouts here.
Right?

done.say: They're all down. Time to take down Veil, I bet!

phase.briefing: More than adequate, {player}. Eliminate the Exiles at one further location and you will have disposed of this hindrance to the Machines.

enter.say:
Wait... this has nothing to do with Veil! I-- what the hell is going on here?
Take these Exiles out, and then we're going to get an answer!

done.say: That's it! We've done this... now time to get out of there and get some answers from Gray!

mission.finish:
Your performance today has been splendid, {player}. It is refreshing to know that you are serving our cause. Unquestioningly.
That is all.
